figurative_meaning_en: to be caught or subdued; to get one's comeuppance
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজ থাক, একদিন না একদিন তুমি টের পাবে।
তার অহংকারের জন্য সে শেষে টের পেয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Wait today, one day you'll get yours.
His arrogance finally caught up with him.
note: This idiom implies inevitable justice or punishment for wrongdoing, common in moralistic Bengali expressions.
